messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected: east1-primary GPU pool 'hot-pool-1' queue depth > 95% and 99th p99 latency spike. Autoscaler triggered but no additional nodes provisioned (scale attempt failed).
alert-bot: page sent to @oncall-jess :rotating_light: — reason: autoscale error + sustained queue growth. Links: https://observability/redwood/incidents/2355550000
oncall-jess: got the page, looking. @sre-maya are you around? any recent deploys to east1?
sre-maya: I'm here. No deploys in last 30m. Seeing lots of requests with long KV cache misses. Logs: `inference.request.queue_len = 1248`, `pool_size=40`.
eng-kavi: looking at control plane — autoscale attempts show failures: `failed to allocate gpu nodes: quota_exceeded` on region east1. Cloud console shows quota at limit for our quota group.
platform-alejandro: confirming: east1 GPU quota reached, upcoming reservations exhausted. We have spare capacity in east2 and eu1.
oncall-jess: plan: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing to east2 for non-low latency customers, 2) attempt emergency manual pool carve in east1 (if possible), 3) update CS page.
prod-observability-bot: current impact: ~27% of requests are throttled with 429, errors rising for customers running low-latency configs. Error rate 5xx -> 3.4x baseline across affected routes.
customer-success-ron: heads up — two paying customers reported degraded response times. I'm on the phone with one, telling them it's a capacity issue, ETA unknown. Please post customer-visible status once we have fallback enabled.
sre-maya: trying manual scale: running `redwoodctl pool resize --region east1 --pool hot-pool-1 --desired 60` returns `QuotaExceeded: cannot provision additional GPUs`.
eng-kavi: autoscale logs show repeated attempts with backoff; control-plane refuses because of quota policy. We can spin up east2 pools and route traffic there, but we need to validate model variant compatibility for two high-priority models (gptx-large and redwood-olive-v2).
oncall-jess: eng-kavi, can you run compatibility check and announce when east2 is warm? I'll open a canary route of 10% to east2.
eng-kavi: running compatibility checks: 
```
# verify model variants
redwoodctl model check-compat --from east1 --to east2 --models gptx-large,redwood-olive-v2
# output: gptx-large -> compatible (quantized match)
# redwood-olive-v2 -> minor kv-cache mismatch, requires variant fallback
```
eng-kavi: gptx-large is good. olive-v2 needs KV cache warmup; we can route olive-v2 traffic to a compatible lower-safety variant `olive-v2-quant` with same interface. Need decision for customer-facing routing for that model.
platform-alejandro: I've prepared east2 pools: `hot-pool-2` with 80 GPUs available but not yet attached to routing table. Manual attach takes ~90s once I flip the control-plane flag.
oncall-jess: proceed with east2 attach and open canary 10% for non-SLA routes. @customer-success-ron keep customers posted: initial canary will route low-priority traffic.
customer-success-ron: told them that we'll try fallback to east2 for non-low-latency traffic. They asked if there will be any data residency changes — noted.
sre-maya: flipping flag now: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --from-region east1 --to-region east2 --percent 10 --match 'priority!=high'` -> success.
prod-observability-bot: canary traffic to east2 observed. queue depth east1 dropping slowly. error 429s reduced by ~18% in first 3m.
oncall-jess: good. Next: if east2 can handle extra load, increase to 40% and then try emergency re-route for remaining customers while we request quota increases.
eng-kavi: attempting warmup for olive-v2: starting KV cache prewarm jobs on east2; estimated warmup 7m. While that's warming, I'll route olive-v2 to `olive-v2-quant` variant on east2 for compatibility.
platform-alejandro: warning: some internal services flagged as 'latency-sensitive' and will not be rerouted by policy. We should coordinate with teams if we need to override.
oncall-jess: override policy: enable emergency override for `platform-critical` tag for 30m to allow routing if we need to. @platform-alejandro please prepare the audit entry.
platform-alejandro: override enabled, audit entry created: `override_2355550000_emergency_route` by platform-alejandro.
eng-kavi: increased fallback to 40% for non-high priority. Observability: east2 CPU/GPU utilization climbs to 55%, queue stabilizes.
prod-observability-bot: metrics summary after 15m: east1 queue depth fell from 1248 -> 420, 429s reduced 55% overall, 5xx down to 1.1x baseline.
sre-maya: next blocker: quota request for east1 will take hours to approve. We should plan sustained routing to east2 for 6+ hours while we pursue quota. Also enabling caching tweaks to reduce KV misses: `kv.cache.hit_boost=1.2` rolling patch announced.
oncall-jess: roll patch to reduce misses by 15% — schedule 2m maintenance window. @eng-kavi roll it now as a hotfix.
eng-kavi: rolling patch applied to routing path and cache config in east1. Observability shows KV miss rate dropping slowly.
customer-success-ron: telling customers we've put fallbacks in place; some will still see slightly higher latency but no hard failures. OK to escalate to exec comms if any high-rev customers ask.
alert-bot: Customer-impact summary: 3 enterprise customers with degraded latency, no data loss reported. Escalation: notify CRO if any customer demands SLA credit.
oncall-jess: oncall handoff note: I'm going offline in ~30m. @sre-maya please take active ops after my handoff at 2355550600. I'll post a handoff summary.
sre-maya: ACK, I'll take it. Please include what we've done and next steps in thread.
oncall-jess: handoff: we enabled 10% -> 40% fallback to east2 for non-high-priority; manual pool carve failed due to quota; emergency override enabled for platform-critical; cache hotfix rolled; KV prewarm in progress for olive-v2; monitoring for 1h, primary goal: ensure east2 continues to absorb 40% and reduce 429s to <10%. If east2 approaches 80% utilization, rollback plan: re-enable stricter throttling and contact platform to escalate quota emergency.
sre-maya: noted. I'll keep periodic updates here. Opening incident page and tagging incident-manager.
prod-observability-bot: periodic update: 30m since start: 429s down 60%, queue east1 stable at ~380, east2 utilization 62%. No new customer complaints in last 10m.
customer-success-ron: I've asked customers to expect a follow-up within 2 hours. They appreciate proactive updates.
eng-kavi: small blip: one route to eu1 had a model variant mismatch during routing test, I reverted that change. No customer impact.
oncall-jess: thanks. leaving now — paging to oncall in 30m if escalates. Good job everyone. :wave:
sre-maya: taking over monitoring. If anything spikes I will escalate to platform-alejandro and eng-kavi.
prod-observability-bot: final entry for this thread period: incident state = mitigated (partial fallback) — follow-ups: submit quota emergency request, formal incident timeline, and post-incident retro.
